1. Z7GOZK: Round trip from Newark (EWR) to Houston, Texas (IAH) on 2024-05-28, basic economy, with return on the same day.

If you need to travel on a different return flight, you would need to cancel this reservation (if eligible) and book a new one. Would you like information on cancellation options, or do you want to proceed differently?
If I can’t change the flight, can you tell me about the cancellation options? I have travel insurance and I’m not feeling well, so I might need to cancel.

Since you have travel insurance and your reason for cancellation is health-related, you are eligible to cancel your reservation and receive a full refund.

Would you like to proceed with cancelling reservation Z7GOZK due to health reasons? Please confirm if you want to continue with the cancellation.
Yes, please go ahead and cancel reservation Z7GOZK due to health reasons.
